title_en: May you be damned, oh foreign country
background: A pechalba song from the other side: the woman who waits. Curse the foreign land that separated us. All the pechalbari came home; only my love did not. She asks the returning men whether they saw him, and waits at the gate day and night. In the third year a letter arrives: don't wait, he has married another.
background_source: Source of these notes: Qwen's draft.

lines.en: May you be damned, oh foreign country,
because you take away my beloved.

lines.cyr: што го љубев време три години.
lines.lat: što go ljubev vreme tri godini.
lines.en: the one I loved three years long.
All the workers come back home from abroad,
but my beloved is not amongst them.
Day and night I wait for him at the gate;

lines.cyr: само плачам и на него мислам.
lines.lat: samo plačam i na nego mislam.
lines.en: I only can cry and worry about him.
Say, can I ask you young workers from abroad,

lines.cyr: од печалба дома да си иде?
lines.lat: od pečalba doma da si ide?
lines.en: whether he returned from his work abroad?
After three years he sent me a letter

lines.cyr: и ми пиши нема да се врати.
lines.lat: i mi piši nema da se vrati.
lines.en: and tells me that he will not return home.

lines.cyr: Не се враќа, друга си заљубил
lines.lat: Ne se vraḱa, druga si zaljubil
lines.en: He will not return, because he found another love

lines.cyr: и за неа тој си се оженил.
lines.lat: i za nea toj si se oženil.
lines.en: and with her he married already.
